about: Pass 8 (2026-10-09/10): new text-to-speech and speech-to-text models not yet in data/models.json, with their results from allowed sources. Nothing in data/ was edited. Apply with `node scripts/import.ts` (models, results, benchmarks; `suggested_tasks` on new benchmarks is a proposal for data/tasks.json); add ledger entries by hand: `action: new` entries go to data/sources.json as written, `add_match` appends the listed paths to that entry's match list, `scope_note` only extends the entry's scope text. Validated in a scratch copy: all ledger changes plus 46 models, 243 results and 5 benchmarks apply with no duplicate against data/ (model id/name, model+bench+source, and model+bench+ledger id), `node scripts/check.ts --validate-only` passes (1,362 models, 14,776 results, 829 benchmarks, 776 sources), every result URL resolves to the ledger id in its source_id, and every new model has at least one counted cell under lib/score.ts toCells.

benchmarks.name: CoSE-E enterprise code-switching · 4 European pairs mean WER
benchmarks.setup: CoSE-E (arXiv:2609.35645v1): 1,212 linguistically validated enterprise-domain code-switched utterances (customer service / IT support) in five language pairs, synthesized with ElevenLabs Multilingual v2 (European pairs) and v3 (ZH/EN), 10 voices, 24 kHz. Eight ASR systems run by the authors with native automatic language detection and no language ID (Table 8). WER = mean of per-utterance WER per pair. Score = unweighted mean of the four European pairs' WER (ES/EN, FR/EN, FR-CA/EN, DE/EN; Friedman N = 918 European utterances), derived from Table 2 cells.
benchmarks.score_unit: error ratio (derived mean of four printed per-pair WERs)
caveats: Synthetic TTS audio (ElevenLabs); the paper notes possible vendor bias in favour of ElevenLabs Scribe v2 and that results are an upper bound (no telephony, disfluency or noise).
Macro mean over four pairs is derived, not printed; ZH/EN (Chinese-script WER/CER) excluded because three systems have no ZH/EN result.
Gemini-3-Flash (preview) and Qwen3-Omni-Instruct rows not imported: they are general LLM/omni models, not stt catalogue entries.
Whisper-large-v3-turbo row kept but invalid: under automatic language detection it translates instead of transcribing (paper reports it separately).

benchmarks.name: Iberian ASR benchmark · 7-language macro WER (eu, ca, gl, pt, es + de, tr)
benchmarks.setup: arXiv:2609.36920v1 (Telefónica / UAM): 85 hours of read speech, broadcast media and audiobooks from openly licensed corpora (Table 1: e.g. OpenSLR 69/76/77, Common Voice-derived sets) in Basque, Catalan, Galician, Portuguese and Spanish with German and Turkish as controls; eleven systems run by the authors with default settings on one RTX 3090. WER per language, then unweighted macro-average across the seven languages (Eq. 1), as printed in Table 3.
caveats: Languages outside a model's training set (e.g. Basque/Catalan/Galician/Turkish for Parakeet v3 and Canary v2) dominate their macro WER; the score measures coverage as much as accuracy.
Datasets differ in domain per language (paper §3.3), so per-language comparisons are cautioned.

benchmarks.name: mu-bench voice-agent caller utterances · batch UER (5 locales)
